scope: Read-only pinned Anvil lifecycle investigation; not actual reorg acceptance
finding: The pinned anvil_reorg empty replacement path does not reinsert orphaned mined L1 transactions into its Pool. It constructs an empty replacement map; backend rollback unwinds chain/state and then explicitly mines empty vectors. Existing pending Pool transactions are not cleared by this path.
recommendation: No transaction deletion or nonce/state override.
Observe empty pending L1 pool before and after replacement while publishers are paused; preserve actual chain, archiver, world-state and original-transaction validation gates.
Require same retained ancestor and exact replacement suffix, and fail on unexpected pending transactions.
draftParentFeedback: Fresh explicit sequencer pause and three-way checkpoint barrier address prior restart-in-finally concern.
Marker cold reopen precedes first post-fork preference read and uses same store.
Replacement paid outcome must be collected and persisted before mandatory success assertions, including failed submit/reconcile outcomes.
limits: No Anvil service or actual fork executed.
Uncommitted parent draft is not source-approved.
SDK publishers independently resubmitting work are not ruled out solely by Anvil source.
